name: GIB2A POWER - FrSky Neuron ESC Telemetry

releaseNotes.content:
# GIB2A POWER v26.1.2

Advanced FrSky Neuron ESC Telemetry Dashboard for ETHOS

- Improved Smart Battery estimated state-of-charge calculation
- Independent empirical GIB2A LiPo SOC curve
- Linear interpolation between calibration points
- Improved RPM 0 behavior: SOC follows the voltage-based target
- Initial SOC uses the current voltage after stabilization
- Existing alarms, callouts, telemetry mappings, and layouts preserved

Verify the installation and telemetry sources on the target radio before flight.
